commentary.executive_summary: Actual YTD EBITDA is NOK 14.35m below budget at NOK 130.00m, with EBITDA margin 1.52 percentage points below budget. Revenue and gross profit are also below budget, while OPEX is NOK 6.09m above budget. Approved evidence links contractor acceleration to the Product & R&D cost centre and Contractors account; the underlying causes of the other material variances remain unresolved from the available evidence.
